name: plan-tooling-scoping-decisions
body: `apg_plan_phases` reports the requirements the current project/branch owns. In-scope means the branch-added requirements together with the requirements this project's phases Satisfy; branch-added mirrors the binary's `solution_nodes_added_on_branch` (`rust.apg.plan_cmd.verify.solution_nodes_added_on_branch`, `src/plan_cmd/verify.rs`), a layer node file present on this branch and absent from the default branch. Preserved findings are a phase with zero tasks, a done-but-under-review task, and Gates cycles. Project-local findings are `unsatisfied` (in-scope requirements whose Satisfies set is empty for this project) and `over-satisfied` (requirements Satisfied by more than one phase of this project). `requirements.requirement.plan-phases-project-scoping` is contained by `requirements.user.graph-consumer`; it drives `domain.group.plan-tooling`, `domain.entity.plan-phases-tool`, and `domain.value.project-requirement-scope`; the group and entity are realised by `solution.container.opencode-suite`, which is implemented by `opencode-suite/tools/apg_plan_phases.ts`, `opencode-suite/lib/apg.ts`, `opencode-suite/lib/apg.test.ts`, and `opencode-suite/tests/boundary.e2e.test.ts`. `requirements.constraint.plan-tooling-change-boundary` governs the requirement, and `solution.constraint.suite-is-product-source` governs the container; the global law that bounds e2e tests to scratch `/tmp` repos governs the e2e test.
